positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Directory of Technology
positions.description:
- Led the design and development of the NHBT App that was downloaded 1000+ times and received over 4 million read/writes to the database in a span of 3 days.
- Features of the app included live scores, live player stats, player information, team information, standings, brackets, leaderboards, and other events throughout the tournament.
- Designed and developed an online scoreboard which scorekeepers used to keep track of scores, rebounds, assists, and fouls which was then displayed in real-time on the app.
